verdict.rationale: Rainforest explicitly documents a full sandbox testing environment with test cards and test bank accounts that simulate approved/declined outcomes without touching real payment data, plus 'full end-to-end sandbox testing' as a marketed feature and a distinct going-live/production transition flow. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on third-party corroboration of sandbox fidelity, and no explicit statement on data isolation guarantees between sandbox and production beyond implication.
